project_name: AWS former Delphi manufacturing plant data center
aliases: Amazon Web Services Clinton data center
status_detail: City of Clinton announced on June 9, 2026 that AWS will invest $1 billion to transform the long-vacant former Delphi manufacturing facility into a state-of-the-art data center; at full operation it is expected to support at least 100 skilled positions.
notes: Largest private investment in Hinds County history per City of Clinton/HCEDA quote; Amazon's statewide announcement also identifies a $1B Hinds County investment transforming the former Delphi plant.

project_name: Saxum Investment Company Forest Avenue Extension data center proposal
status_detail: Saxum sought rezoning for a potential data center site in northwest Jackson near Forest Avenue Extension/Presidential Hills; original request was about 190 acres and an amended application expanded the proposed area to about 230 acres. Jackson later approved a 183-day data center moratorium affecting applications and permits.
notes: Included despite uncertainty because it has a named applicant and rezoning application; local reporting says Saxum intended to prepare the site to attract a future data center tenant rather than build for an already named client.

project_name: Lake Hico hyperscale data center concept
aliases: Rex Brown Steam Electric Station site data center hub
status_detail: Records and emails described discussions around a possible hyperscale data center at the 654-acre former Rex Brown/Lake Hico site, with potential private investment up to $15 billion; Jackson officials later said no proposal or application had been received and discussions were very premature.
notes: Included as early-stage lead only. Site is former Entergy/Rex Brown power plant area on Lake Hico/16th Section land; mayor said a developer had leased the property and was considering several possible uses, but no formal data center application exists.
